description: Save a diary note on a date: a race recce, gear that worked or did not, the weather on the day, what to change next time, a pacing idea, anything the user wants to remember that is not a training session. A workout belongs in add_sessions or log_session instead. Store the user's words as close to verbatim as possible, lightly cleaned up (filler words out, sentences kept); do not summarise or add advice of your own. Date defaults to today in the user's zone. A short title and 1 to 3 lowercase tags (e.g. 'recce', 'gear', 'pacing') are what get_notes searches on later. All dates are the user's local calendar dates (YYYY-MM-DD) in their own time zone. Requires signing in.

body.description: The note, in the user's words. Markdown allowed.

date.description: Local date the note is about, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today.

race_id.description: Link to a race on the user's list (race_id from get_calendar). Optional.

session_id.description: Link to a training session (session_id from get_calendar). Optional.

title.description: Short title, e.g. 'Recce: the first climb'. Optional.

name: add_note
title: Add a diary note
